app.name: DBLoom
login.title: Sign in to a database server
login.warning: Direct mode: you sign in with your database account. DBLoom accounts, enforced two-factor sign-in and saved connections are not available.
login.serverHint: Host name or address, with an optional port (db.internal:3306)
session.ended.title: Your session has ended
session.ended.body: Sign in again to continue. Unsaved work on this page is kept.
empty.title: Open a table
empty.body: Choose a database on the left, then a table, to see its rows.
assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.body: Not configured. An administrator has to connect an AI service before you can ask questions about your data.
structure.readOnlyBadge: Read-only connection: you can preview, not run
structure.readOnlyReason: Read-only connection: the SQL can be previewed but not run.
structure.unsupported: Not supported by this server version
structure.lists.error: Engines and character sets could not be loaded.
structure.definition.unavailable: The current definition of this table cannot be loaded yet.
structure.designer.problems: {count} problems to fix before the preview
structure.col.name: Name
structure.index.name: Index name
structure.index.duplicate: Another index already covers these columns.
structure.fk.title: Foreign key
structure.fk.name: Constraint name
structure.check.title: CHECK constraint
structure.check.name: Constraint name
structure.err.stalePlan: The table changed since the preview. Review the changes again with a new preview.
structure.err.planExpired: This preview has expired or was already used. Create a new preview to continue.
structure.err.readOnly: This connection is read-only, so nothing was changed.
structure.err.token: The confirmation is missing or not valid. Create a new preview and confirm again.
structure.err.tokenExpired: The confirmation has expired. Create a new preview and confirm again.
structure.err.tokenUsed: This confirmation was already used. Create a new preview and confirm again.
structure.err.notFound: That object does not exist any more.
structure.err.kindMismatch: This object is a different kind than the request assumed (table or view). Reload the sidebar and try again.
structure.err.timeout: The statement ran longer than the time limit and was stopped.
structure.comment.fourByte: This comment has characters outside the basic plane (such as emoji). MySQL and MariaDB store column comments as 3-byte text, so they would be saved as ?.
structure.err.invalidName: A name cannot end with a space or contain a NUL character
structure.err.duplicate: Another column already has this name
structure.err.scale: Scale cannot be larger than the precision
structure.err.defaultType: CURRENT_TIMESTAMP only works for DATETIME and TIMESTAMP
structure.err.defaultNull: A column that does not allow NULL cannot default to NULL
structure.err.onePrimary: A table has one primary key
structure.err.primaryName: Only the primary key is named PRIMARY
structure.err.unknownColumn: This column does not exist in the table
structure.err.fkCount: Both sides need the same number of columns, all chosen
structure.preview.title: Preview of the SQL
structure.preview.commits: MySQL and MariaDB apply each structure statement immediately. It cannot be rolled back.
structure.preview.sequence: These statements run one after another; MySQL commits each one and cannot undo earlier ones.
structure.preview.expired: This preview has expired. Create a new preview to continue.
structure.confirm.typeNameHint: The name has to match exactly.
structure.confirm.acknowledge: I understand that this deletes data permanently.
structure.done.title: Done
structure.failed.title: A statement failed
structure.failed.body: Statements before the failed one were applied and are not undone. Later statements did not run.
structure.db.create.title: New database
structure.db.name: Database name
structure.drop.db.title: Drop database {name}
structure.drop.db.body: All tables and data in this database will be deleted.
structure.drop.table.title: Drop table {name}
structure.drop.view.title: Drop view {name}
structure.drop.view.body: The view definition will be deleted. The data of the tables behind it is not affected.
structure.drop.table.body: The table and all its rows will be deleted.
structure.truncate.title: Empty table {name}
structure.truncate.body: All rows will be deleted and the auto-increment counter starts again.
structure.fkChecks.ignore: Ignore foreign key checks for this statement
structure.rename.title: Rename {name}
sql.tab.title: SQL {n}
sql.tab.label: SQL editor and results
sql.editor.label: SQL editor
sql.view.label: SQL statement
sql.analyse.title: Analyse runs the statement and reports actual timings
sql.readOnly.blocked: Read-only connection: only reads can run here.
sql.sessionOnly: Kept for this session only. It is gone when you log out or the server restarts.
sql.results.empty: Results appear here. Press {key}+Enter to run the editor text, or the selection if there is one.
sql.results.label: Results
sql.results.title: Results
sql.grid.label: Result rows
sql.result.truncatedRows: Showing the first {shown} rows. The statement returned more; add LIMIT, or raise the limit (up to {limit}).
sql.result.truncatedBytes: Showing the first {shown} rows. The result was cut by size.
sql.strip.label: SQL that ran
sql.err.busy: Two statements are already running. Wait for one to finish or cancel it.
sql.err.disabled: The SQL tab is switched off on this server.
sql.err.multi: This server accepts one statement at a time.
sql.err.tooLarge: The text is longer than 1 MiB and cannot run.
sql.err.tooMany: Too many statements in one run.
sql.err.unterminatedString: A string is not closed. Nothing ran.
sql.err.unterminatedComment: A comment is not closed. Nothing ran.
sql.err.bookmarkExists: A bookmark with this name already exists.
sql.err.bookmarkLimit: The bookmark limit is reached. Delete one first.
sql.err.notImplemented: This part of the SQL tab is not available yet.
sql.err.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again; the text in the editor is kept.
sql.reason.noWhere: No WHERE condition, so every row is affected.
sql.reason.constantWhere: The condition is always true, so every row is affected.
sql.reason.limitOnly: Only a LIMIT restricts it, with no condition.
sql.reason.alterDrop: Drops a column, index or constraint.
sql.reason.narrowing: Narrows a column, which can cut or lose values.
sql.reason.unparsed: DBLoom could not analyse this statement, so it asks first.
sql.reason.unknownKeyword: Unknown statement type, so it asks first.
sql.reason.parserOff: Analysis is switched off on this server, so it asks first.
sql.reason.budget: The analysis ran out of time, so it asks first.
sql.confirm.titleHard: Confirm statements that can delete data
sql.confirm.bodySoft: The server asks for a confirmation before these run.
sql.confirm.bodyHard: The server checked these statements and will run them only after you confirm. Nothing ran yet.
sql.confirm.transaction: Runs in one transaction: committed if every statement succeeds, rolled back at the first error.
sql.confirm.autocommit: Each statement is committed as soon as it runs. Changes cannot be rolled back afterwards.
sql.confirm.fkOff: Foreign key checks are off for this run, so rows that other tables reference can be removed.
sql.confirm.acknowledge: I understand that these statements run on the server as written.
sql.confirm.expired: This confirmation has expired. Cancel and run the statements again.
sql.explain.label: Explain output
sql.explain.title: Explain
sql.explain.analyseNote: Analyse runs the statement to measure it.
sql.explain.noTree: The output has no tree shape here. The raw output is below.
sql.opt.title: Options
sql.opt.continueHint: Later statements still run when one fails.
sql.opt.transactionHint: Commit only if all succeed; roll back after the first error.
sql.opt.fk: Disable foreign key checks for this run
sql.opt.fkHint: Off by default. Applies to this run only.
sql.opt.soft: Also confirm statements that change data
sql.opt.softHint: Statements that can delete data are always confirmed.
sql.opt.implicitCommit: Some statements here end the transaction by themselves; earlier changes stay.
sql.opt.sessionNote: Session settings such as SET and user variables end with each run. Options reset when the page reloads.
sql.drawer.label: History and bookmarks
sql.history.empty: Nothing has run on this server yet.
sql.history.omitted: The text was too long to keep.
sql.bookmark.name: Name
sql.bookmark.redactNote: Passwords in the text are replaced before it is stored.
sql.bookmark.empty: No bookmarks for this server yet.
sql.close.title: Close this SQL tab?
sql.close.body: The text in the editor has not run or been saved as a bookmark. Closing the tab discards it.
